name: 旋风镭射
desc: 「超时空战斗机 V形蛇」才能装备。攻击力上升300。并且这张卡向守备表示怪兽攻击时若攻击力超过那个守备力，给与对方那个数值的战斗伤害。
faq: The effect of this card only applies to the "Gradius" that it is equipped to.
ruling:
The effect of “Cyclon Laser” applies only to the equipped “Gradius.”
The effect of “Cyclon Laser” does not apply to any “Gradius’ Option” that target the equipped “Gradius.”
